name: CodeAct
titleZh: 可执行代码动作能造出更好的 LLM 智能体
summary: Replaces JSON or fixed-format action strings with executable Python, so an agent can compose tools and revise its own earlier actions.
summaryZh: 用可执行的 Python 取代 JSON 或固定格式的动作串，让智能体能自由组合工具、并回头修改自己先前的动作。
keyFact: CodeAct (Wang et al., arXiv:2402.01030, 2024-02-01) unified an agent's actions as executable Python and reported up to 20% higher success rate than JSON- or text-formatted action baselines, across an analysis of 17 LLMs.
keyFactZh: CodeAct（Wang 等，arXiv:2402.01030，2024-02-01）把智能体动作统一为可执行 Python，在 17 个模型的分析中报告成功率比 JSON／文本格式的动作基线最高提升 20%。
whyItMatters: It is why "code as actions" has largely displaced fixed tool schemas in coding and data agents.
whyItMattersZh: 这就是为什么在编码与数据类 Agent 里，「用代码当动作」已经基本取代了固定工具 schema。
title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents
